_comment: Curated EDIABAS job allowlist for BMW/MINI. ONLY jobs listed here can be run through /api/{brand}/ediabas/run. kind=read jobs run freely; kind=write jobs require confirm:true and show 'confirm' as the prompt. Adding a function = adding an entry here (plus verifying it on a real car -- mark it 'verify': true until then).

common.name: IDENTIFIKATION
common.description: Module identity: part number, hardware/software versions, diagnostic index. (Some variants call the job IDENT -- tried automatically.)

common.name: FS_LESEN
common.description: Read the module's fault memory (manufacturer-level, with environment data).

common.name: FS_LOESCHEN
common.confirm: Clears ALL stored faults on this module.

common.name: STEUERGERAETE_RESET
common.description: Reboot the module (same as a battery disconnect for that ECU).
common.confirm: The module restarts; its functions drop out for a few seconds.

zgw.name: STATUS_VCM_GET_ECU_LIST_ALL
zgw.description: Ask the gateway which control units this car actually has (its stored SVT list), instead of probing addresses blind. One result set per module: name + diagnostic address.
zgw.note: Confirmed present in zgw_01.PRG on disk. Results: STAT_SG_ANZAHL, STAT_SG_NAME_TEXT, STAT_SG_DIAG_ADRESSE.

zgw.name: STATUS_VCM_I_STUFE_LESEN
zgw.description: Read the car's integration level (I-Stufe) -- the factory and current software build state of the whole vehicle.

dme.name: STEUERN_BATTERIETAUSCH_REGISTRIEREN
dme.description: Register a battery replacement with the engine's power management. Run this AFTER fitting a new battery: charging strategy and start/stop behaviour stay wrong until the car is told the battery is new.
dme.note: UDS $31 01 F030 per the SGBD. Confirmed present in DME_BX8.prg (the F56's own engine ECU) and in the N55/N62/S55/S63/POW_E65 families. Takes no arguments.
dme.confirm: Tells the engine ECU a new battery has been fitted and resets its charge history. Only do this if the battery really has been replaced.

dme.name: STATUS_MESSWERTE_IBS
dme.description: Battery sensor (IBS) live measurements: battery temperature, voltage and current, straight from the sensor on the negative terminal.
dme.note: UDS $22 402B. The honest state-of-health picture that pairs with battery registration.

dme.name: STATUS_SYSTEMCHECK_AEP_INFO_2
dme.description: Battery condition as the car judges it: state of health in percent, rated capacity in Ah, state of charge and battery temperature.
dme.note: The power-management store. STAT_SOH_WERT is the number worth quoting on a used car.

dme.name: STATUS_SYSTEMCHECK_AEP_INFO_1
dme.description: Battery charge history: total charge and discharge in Ah, the running balance, and the mileage at the last two battery changes.
dme.note: STAT_BATTERIETAUSCH_LETZTER_WERT is the readback that proves a battery registration landed -- after registering it should read the car's current mileage.

hu.name: STEUERN_SERVICEHISTORY_ADD
hu.description: Add one entry to the car's own iDrive service history. Oldest entries first; a module reset is needed before it shows on screen.

params.name: argument
params.hint: The 61-field argument string -- build it on the Service History page, paste it here

hu.confirm: Writes a permanent entry to the head unit's service history.

hu.name: STEUERN_SERVICEHISTORY_ERASE
hu.description: Erase the ENTIRE in-car service history. No per-entry delete exists.
hu.confirm: Wipes ALL service-history entries from the head unit. There is no undo.

kombi.name: CBS_RESET
kombi.description: Reset one CBS service item after the work is done. Ten positional arguments; every one after the item name defaults to a 'no change' sentinel, so setting just the item is the normal use.
kombi.note: Argument list read from the F56's own komb25.prg documentation (CBS version 5). The G-series clusters (KOMB_G11/J29) have an eleventh argument, CHOV_CBS_CBR_VIEW, and document a precondition of the car being driving-ready. Use the CBS page rather than this raw job unless you know exactly which cluster you are on.

params.name: CBS_KENNUNG
params.hint: Item: Oel, Br_v, Br_h, Brfl, Sic, Sic_v, TUV, AU, Ueb, Efk, NOx_a

params.name: CBS_VERFUEGBARKEIT
params.hint: Remaining life 0-100 percent (150 allowed for brake fluid); 255 = no change

params.name: CBS_ANZAHL_SERVICE
params.hint: Services carried out 0-30; 31 = add one to the counter

params.name: CBS_ZIEL_MONAT
params.hint: Target month 1-12 for MOT/emissions; 15 = no change

params.name: RMM_CBS_WERT
params.hint: Remaining distance in km or %; 32768 (0x8000) = no change

params.name: ST_UN_CBS_RSTG
params.hint: Unit of the above: 0 = %, 1 = km x10, 15 = don't care

params.name: FRC_INTM_WAY_CBS_MESS
params.hint: Forecast distance interval 1-254 (x1000 km); 0 = back to default, 255 = no change

params.name: FRC_INTM_T_CBS_MESS
params.hint: Forecast time interval 0-254 months; 255 = no change

kombi.confirm: Resets the chosen service item's counter on the instrument cluster. CBS lives in the cluster and is mirrored to the key; it is separate from the iDrive service history.

kombi.name: CBS_DATEN_LESEN
kombi.description: Read every CBS item the cluster holds: remaining life in percent, remaining distance, and the service counter. Read-only -- run this before and after a reset.
kombi.note: UDS $22. One result set per CBS item; the harness reads all sets, not just the last.

kombi.name: CBS_INFO
kombi.description: Which CBS version this cluster speaks. Version 5 (F-series) and version 6 (G-series) take different reset arguments, so this is the check that says which is safe.

kombi.name: CBS_RESET_DETAIL_LESEN
kombi.description: Read why a CBS reset was refused (CBS_RUECK_GRUND). G-series clusters only.
kombi.note: CORRECTED 2026-07-29: this job does NOT exist in komb25.prg -- the F56's cluster. The earlier 'no response, needs driving-ready state' finding was a missing job, not a missing precondition. Present in KOMB_G11/KOMB_J29; harmless to try elsewhere, it will simply not resolve.
